episodes.title: An Unexpected Twist
episodes.summary: College student Lee Won Joon moves into a sharehouse, and meets a beautiful yet strangely familiar housemate — but they get off on the wrong foot.

episodes.title: Getting to Know Each Other
episodes.summary: Gradually, Lee Doona gets acquainted with Won Joon's social circle. He later celebrates Doona's birthday, attempting to get to know her better.

episodes.title: Spring Breeze
episodes.summary: Alone in her room, Doona feels unsafe — like she's being watched. Won Joon and Kim Jin Joo go out to see the cherry blossoms, but it starts to pour.

episodes.title: The Unexpected
episodes.summary: Won Joon and Doona grab a late-night meal, experiencing their first paparazzi moment. Much to his disdain, Won Joon accidentally reunites with an old foe.

episodes.title: Meaningless Kiss
episodes.summary: A confused Won Joon confronts Doona about the sudden kiss. New housemates move into the sharehouse, making the place livelier than ever.

episodes.title: Twilight Zone
episodes.summary: Doona secretly visits Dream Sweet's showcase event. Later, she invites Won Joon on a spontaneous trip to her childhood home.

episodes.title: Clear the Air
episodes.summary: After the return of a person from her past, Doona makes a rash decision. Won Joon later confronts Doona in a moment of pain and frustration.

episodes.title: Typical and Ordinary
episodes.summary: As Won Joon and Doona's relationship flourishes, a chance at a comeback comes knocking on Doona's door — but so do the tough choices.

episodes.title: Doona!
episodes.summary: Won Joon moves into a new apartment and focuses on his studies. Meanwhile, Doona's career soars as she finds newfound confidence.
